One line per game: what kind of game was it?

Source: R/games.R
game_summary.Rd

One line per game: what kind of game was it?

Usage

game_summary(pbp, params = NULL)

Arguments

pbp

Play-by-play in the ggbasket layout (see pbp), one or more games.

params

Win-probability parameters, see win_probability().

Value

A tibble per game: teams and final score, lead_changes, ties, home_max_lead, away_max_lead, best_run (label), excitement (total win-probability movement: how much the game swung), comeback (the winner's lowest win probability), overtime.
